requirement.description: The __eq__ method in External class fails when comparing bytes objects due to attempting to call .items() on bytes objects, causing AttributeError.
requirement.contract: When comparing an External object with a bytes object, the comparison should handle bytes properly without trying to call .items() method. The comparison should either convert bytes to string for comparison or handle the comparison appropriately based on the underlying data type.

requirement.description: External objects fail to load from storage locations that don't exist, raising UsageError with unclear message about non-existing location.
requirement.contract: When an external object tries to load from a non-existing location, it should provide a clear error message indicating the missing resource and suggest possible solutions like running with --inline-snapshot=create.

requirement.description: The lookup mechanism for UUID-based external files fails to correctly resolve file paths, leading to StorageLookupError when trying to load external objects.
requirement.contract: The UUID storage should correctly resolve file paths for external objects by properly mapping the UUID-based location to actual file paths in the storage directory.
